item-descriptions.5.56-ammo: Standard rifle ammunition, chambered for assault rifles.
item-descriptions.apple-cider: An alcoholic beverage made out of apples. Drink moderately.
item-descriptions.apple-whiskey: A fermented and distilled alcoholic beverage. It's technically applejack, but people around here call this apple whiskey.
item-descriptions.assault-rifle: A rugged, fully-automatic rifle. Fire single shots, or switch to a burst for more damage at the cost of accuracy control and extra ammo.
item-descriptions.bottlecaps: Bottlecaps, commonly used as a currency in these parts.
item-descriptions.combat-shotgun: A close-range shotgun that can shred through flesh and light armor alike. Not much use at a distance.
item-descriptions.dark-magic-artefact: A small container enclosing a small fragment of dark magic. The container bear the mark of the Umbridge laboratory, where you picked up this peculiar object. Its proximity fills you with a strange sense of power.
item-descriptions.dynamite: A dangerous explosive. It's probably powerful enough to blast through most doors.
item-descriptions.energy-cell: A rechargeable energy cell, used to power laser weaponry.
item-descriptions.food-butter: A soft, fatty foodstuff made by churning the cream of milk.
item-descriptions.frag-grenade: A fragmentation grenade. Mind the pin.
item-descriptions.gemstone: Precious gems, used as a building material or as an ingredient for magic ritual.
item-descriptions.hoof-blades: A set of curved blades strapped to the hoof. Light, fast, and always within reach.
item-descriptions.laser-rifle: A heavy, saddle-mounted laser weapon. Hits harder and further than its pistol-sized cousin, at the cost of needing two hooves free.
item-descriptions.laser-smg: A compact, rapid-fire laser weapon. Fire single shots, or switch to a burst for more damage at the cost of extra energy cells.
item-descriptions.lockpicking-kit-v2: A lockpicking kit, with more type of hooks than you could ever need. It considerably increases your ability to pick locks.
item-descriptions.lockpicking-kit: A lockpicking kit, with various type of hooks and handles. It's going to be a lot easier to pick locks with these tools.
item-descriptions.metal-armor: An armor made out of pieces of scrap metal bundled together. It looks a bit silly, but sturdy nontheless.
item-descriptions.pickaxe: A pickaxe. It can be used to mine ore. Or to stab enemies.
item-descriptions.rebar-club: A length of rusted rebar, wrapped in scrap for a grip. Crude, heavy, and effective.
item-descriptions.ripper: A vicious knife with a motorized, energy cell-powered blade. Cuts through flesh and armor with ease.
item-descriptions.power-armor: A power armor that the Steel Rangers usually wear. Probably the most protective kind of gear you'll ever find in the wastes. It's pretty damn heavy, but the weight is compensated for by increasing the strength of its wearer, while protecting it of magical radiations.
item-descriptions.power-hoof: A hoof-mounted energy actuator that hits with far more force than any natural kick. Can be tuned for a straightforward strike, or for a shove that sends enemies stumbling backward.
item-descriptions.power-sledgehammer: A sledgehammer retrofitted with an energy cell-powered actuator, striking with tremendous force. Overkill for most jobs. Perfect for this one.
item-descriptions.shotgun-ammo: A shell packed with metal pellets, meant for close-range shotguns.
item-descriptions.skill-book-medicine: A book to learn more about first-aid.
item-descriptions.skill-book-outdoorsman: A book about the outdoors, with many insights on how to set camp and travel safely across the wilderness.
item-descriptions.skill-book-smallGuns: A Gun's and Bullet magazine, full of tips on proper gun use and maintenance.
item-descriptions.sledgehammer: A massive, two-hooved hammer built for demolition. Swing it wide to hit everything in front of you, or line up a single crushing blow.
item-descriptions.sniper-rifle: A long-barreled, saddle-mounted rifle built for precision. Slow to line up a shot, but devastating at long range.
item-descriptions.sparkle-cola: A carrot-flavored carbonated soft drink. Sparkle Cola used to be the most popular beverage in Equestria, prior to and during the Great War.
item-descriptions.stable-suit: Your everyday standard stable suit, issued by Stable Tech.
item-descriptions.trialKey: The key to the Cavern of Trials. It used to belong to Trial Blister. Now it's yours.
item-descriptions.trialStartKey: A rusty key found deep in the cavern of trials.
item-descriptions.note: A note with some text written on it. You'll need to pick it up first to be able to read it.
